## Source discovery, audit, integration, and health

Five previously untracked source/discovery candidate families were screened:

1. Aethon Books;
2. Mountaindale Press;
3. Portal Books;
4. Ascendant Reads;
5. ProgFans.

Aethon Books, Mountaindale Press, and Portal Books received the full admission review. Each exposes a public first-party HTTPS catalog relevant to LitRPG/progression-fantasy discovery. No reviewed origin supplied an explicit machine-interface or content-reuse grant sufficient to justify automated catalog ingestion, and no stable rights/robots/paging/cadence/update fixture set was established for a richer adapter. The safe admitted capability is therefore static **link-only** discovery with WebNR-authored descriptions and labels; WebNR does not copy catalog metadata, covers, prices, ratings, reviews, biographies, retailer data, or book text and performs no origin API/HTML/feed/search polling.

Pull request #111 added `Progression & LitRPG Publisher Discovery Starter` with three passing first-party discovery routes: Aethon Books, Mountaindale Press, and Portal Books. Ascendant Reads and ProgFans remain deferred discovery candidates for later source-specific rights/runtime audit rather than being admitted by association.

The rotating existing-source sample covered `English Web-Fiction Discovery Starter`: Top Web Fiction, SpaceBattles Discover Stories, and Sufficient Velocity Story Library remained publicly reachable in fresh checks. No evidence supported deletion, downgrade, coverage shrinkage, or expansion into automated origin crawling.
